title: UFO Nuclear Test Link Reportedly Debunked by Experts Warning Believers Not To Act Like 'Religion'
author: Briane Nebria
summary: International Business Times reports on a peer-reviewed methodological critique of VASCO-related analyses of pre-Sputnik POSS1 photographic-plate features. The underlying PASA paper reports that the claimed nuclear-test timing correlation becomes statistically insignificant after normalization by relevant observation days and raises additional dataset-validation and artifact concerns; GreyAlien treats those results as a scientific challenge, not as a final resolution of the broader VASCO research dispute.

relationships.context: Latest UAP News surfaces the August 28 reporting while the peer-reviewed PASA paper remains the permanent Research Library object.

editorialNotes.sourceHandling: IBTimes is the timely secondary news surface. The Cambridge/PASA peer-reviewed accepted manuscript is the primary source for the scientific findings.
editorialNotes.evidentiaryDiscipline: The secondary headline uses categorical debunking language; GreyAlien instead describes the paper as a methodological challenge and preserves VASCO rebuttal/replication context.
